instagram.content:
Some books are difficult because the language is distant—not because the ideas are.

I’ve been building a reading shelf where 文言文 sits beside English, modern Japanese, and modern Chinese. It includes 資治通鑑, 漢書, 後漢書, 三國志裴松之注, and 春秋左氏傳. 資治通鑑 has six black-and-white parts. Each of the other named histories has color and black-and-white editions.

Explore the shelf:
https://lazying.art/wenyan/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=wenyan_history

Which history would you open first?
